cases.title: English storyboard quotation style — Android
cases.claim: When storyboard output is English, generated dialogue quotation marks must follow English conventions (straight or curly English quotes), not Chinese-style corner quotes 「 」 or 『 』, unless explicitly requested before generation.

cases.title: Storyboard 文字：錯誤語言 — Android

cases.title: Storyboard 文字：空白 — Android
cases.claim: Storyboard 生成完成後，每個場景的必要生成文字不得缺漏、為空字串或僅含空白。

cases.title: Storyboard 文字：亂碼 — Android
cases.claim: Storyboard 生成完成後，所有生成文字應可正常閱讀，不得含編碼或字元顯示損壞造成的亂碼。

cases.title: Template category header icon fidelity — Android
cases.claim: Every AI Mini Drama template category header displays the icon assigned to that category by the applicable approved design; a repeated default or another category’s icon must not replace the assigned icon. Categories may share an icon only when the approved design assigns the same icon.

cases.title: Template name spelling, grammar and punctuation scan — Android
cases.claim: Every displayed AI Mini Drama story-template name must use correct spelling, grammar and punctuation for its text language, allowing documented intentional names or stylization. The English title “Six Things You Didnt Know” must be “Six Things You Didn’t Know” (a straight apostrophe in Didn't is also acceptable).
